notes.title: 27th March hotfix
notes.content: - Fixed unhandled default locale selector failure. Default locale when locale detection fails will now be English.

tags.bug: - Fixed unhandled default locale selector failure. Default locale when locale detection fails will now be English.

notes.content:
- Flying now starts at near boost speed

- Fixed UI scaling issues in modification menu
- Some minor UI improvements
- Fixed timing bug in Capture objective
- Introduced xp crystal culling for lategame FPS issues
- Fixed level up issue when levels are gained too quickly
- Added GameTester API integration
